heuristics.name: headword-prior
heuristics.description: picked the option that is the most typical plain synonym of a common ISEE-level headword; essentially a guess

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: two options are opposites; key assumed to be one of the pair (antonym distractor alongside key)

heuristics.name: polysemy-trap
heuristics.description: distractors look like other senses of one polysemous headword; picked the remaining sense
